deploymentProfileScope.rule: This contract serves the poc-single-host profile (ADR-020) only. It does not qualify, and no evidence produced under it satisfies, P1, P2 or P3 (ADR-008, ADR-009). The frozen v1 contract (windows-cuda-development-build-v1.json) is unchanged and remains the contract of the sm_75 Windows CUDA Runtime Pack.

toolchain.rule: No Windows CUDA lock or Runtime Pack may be frozen under this contract until nvcc successfully compiles a trivial .cu file for every target GPU with the selected MSVC toolset and Windows SDK.

buildHost.authoritativeBuildLocation: the Development laptop (GTX 1650 Ti, sm_75), accepted by the owner as this contract's build host for the poc-single-host profile only (plan 2026-10-28 decision D9, ADR-020 Consequences)
buildHost.developmentLaptopRole: build host, sm_75 load verification and sm_75 execution; sm_89 execution is not observable here and waits for the demonstration host (register row A7, slice S12)

qualification.rule: A Runtime Pack built under this contract is 'built, hashed, locked' until a bound host observation on the RTX 4090 demonstration host earns it qualified-development-hardware for that host under ADR-009 (register row A7). Nothing here is Production evidence.

statusNote: status is a human-readable phase label and is never proof of anything. The authoritative machine-checked proof is toolchain.verificationStatus together with the frozen toolchain identities, which tools/verify_repo.py validates by shape and cross-checks against the offline catalogue.
nativeAbiNote: Derived from toolchain and targetGpus by tools/vision/build_runtime_pack.py:derive_native_abi, never hand-typed.
